usedFor: Each paid Shopify order becomes an entry the team can sort and comment on in Notion.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Paid is the order that counts, a better log than “New Customer” or “New Product”.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” can run the same action and add a second item.
